text: Implemented a pure bounded EyeLink byte framer plus FS2 pipe and Files adapter. It preserves exact bytes, one-based lines, byte offsets, LF/CRLF/EOF terminators, first-line BOM policy, and emits one parsed/rejected result per physical line; overlong lines retain only the configured budget while exact total length is counted. Arbitrary byte partitions match the pure whole-input oracle; lone CR and overflow resume without byte loss; validated read/line budgets precede allocation. Evidence: 5 shared tests pass JVM and Scala.js; 4 JVM-only tests prove actual Files parity, cancellation finalization, no partial-line flush on cancellation, and 2,000,000 lines without downstream materialization (9 JVM total). Formatting gates pass. Mutation proof changed the line-limit boundary from > to >=; the exact-limit fixture failed, then restoration returned all gates green.
